# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Strong cumulative buying pressure (volume delta) within the opening range (first 30 minutes) indicates smart money accumulation, predicting continued upward momentum as price breaks above the range with confirming volume. This edge exists because institutional order flow often leaves a detectable volume signature before sustained price moves, particularly in low-to-moderate volatility regimes where breakouts are more likely to follow through.

## Mechanism

Calculate opening range (OR) high/low from 09:30-10:00 ET (first 30m 5m bars). Compute cumulative volume delta (buying volume - selling volume) for same period. Enter long when:
- Price closes above OR high
- Cumulative volume delta > 1.5 × its 20-bar average (using prior 20 periods of same OR calculation)
- VWAP (session VWAP) is below breakout price (close above OR high)
Exit: Initial stop at OR low. Take profit at 2× risk (2 × (entry - OR low)) OR trail 15% off highest close after entry. Avoid when OR >0.5% of price (extreme gap) or VIX >25 (chaotic regime). Only trade first hour of session (signals after 10:30 ET invalid).
